THE HARMONIC LANGUAGE

A GUIDE THAT TEACHES BY BEING PLAYED
THE WAYFINDER THE MAP ROOM THE RING THE RESONANCE THE INSTRUMENT THE LANGUAGE THE ASTROLABE THE ROSETTE THE SPECTRUM THE WORKSHOP
I · THE THREE MARKS
Everything in this language is built from one alphabet of three: still (a dot), moving (a bar), turning (a wave). And every word in it is exactly three letters long, one for each depth of a moment: the world around you, the between that joins you to things, the heart. Three marks with three choices each: three times three times three, twenty-seven. That is the whole language. Nothing in it was invented; the counting produced it, and the names came after. Touch the wheels and build a word.
II · THE TWENTY-SEVEN
Here is the whole language at once, laid out so the three marks are literally an address: the mark of the world chooses one of the three tables, the mark of the between chooses the row, the mark of the heart chooses the column. The card you built above is glowing in its own metal: three choices are a place among twenty-seven. Touch any cell to hear it. This is the Living Cube’s lattice, unrolled flat for a first meeting; the cube itself waits in the portal when the three axes are familiar.
 
III · FROM THE CODE TO THE TORUS
 
 
 
Read the three marks as a number: the world counts nines, the between counts threes, the heart counts ones, and stillness counts nothing, a bar adds, a wave takes away. Every word lands on its own number between minus thirteen and thirteen, each exactly once. And that number is a winding recipe: lay a thread on a ring and send it through the hole that many times while it goes around. At whole numbers the thread comes home and closes into a knot, and that knot IS the card’s form. Between the whole numbers it never closes at all: the open water. The procession above walks the whole count on its own, silence at its centre, and on the plate the card now on stage glows, the glow travelling seat to seat as the walk goes. The plate is the hand: touch any card to call its toroid up, watch it tie itself, and hear it; hover to see its answer light across the axis, for reversing every motion turns each word into exactly one other, and together they sum to silence. Switch on IN CONCORDANCE to put that answer on the torus beside its card: one form, two threads, turning opposite ways, because reversing the motions reverses the winding. The Seed answers itself, so it stands alone.
IV · THE GLYPH BENCH
Everything so far has been the language’s shape. Here is one word of it held still and read whole: the card as the deck prints it, its form at one hand and its relations at the other, and beneath, its own words. A card says three things rather than one, because a word means differently depending on where in a moment it stands: at the root, at the present, at the becoming. Choose the tense and the same card speaks again. Walk the deck with the arrow keys, or touch anything above: the wheels, the lattice, the plate. The bench follows whatever the hand chooses, and stands still while the procession walks.
